    nr.action,
    AVG(s.ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
    VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS variance_ip_version,
    STDDEV(s.ip_version) AS stddev_ip_version,
    MAX(s.enable_dhcp) AS dhcp_enabled
  FROM networkrbacs nr
  JOIN subnets s ON nr.object_id = s.network_id

  action,
  avg_ip_version,
  variance_ip_version,
  stddev_ip_version,

    nr.action,
    AVG(s.ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
    VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS variance_ip_version,
    STDDEV(s.ip_version) AS stddev_ip_version,
    MAX(s.enable_dhcp) AS dhcp_enabled
  FROM networkrbacs nr
  JOIN subnets s ON nr.object_id = s.network_id
  WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
  GROUP BY nr.action
)
SELECT 
  action,
  avg_ip_version,
  variance_ip_version,
  stddev_ip_version,
  dhcp_enabled
FROM action_stats
ORDER BY variance_ip_version DESC
LIMIT 10
